markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (97%)** · Confident · Careful review
Whole-slide read is benign [F1], but tier-1 frozen-section margin alerts and focal right-side risk require inspection.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 97%, InSitu 3%, Invasive 0%, Normal 0% | Clear benign lead over InSitu |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage) | Single-class set; 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 98%, OOD 1.0, 12/12 regions [F6] | High reliability; atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (84%–86%); 1/5 InSitu (BACH_0263) [F5] | Mostly benign; one InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 5, 8) · context · Above-typical score (1.98; -1.44 shift), AI check 8/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Typical score (0.14) shifts +0.43; AI check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.20) shifts -0.38; AI check 19/20 [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (1.23) shifts -0.37; AI check 18/20, caption mismatch · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 3, 6) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (1.32) shifts -0.35; AI check 12/20 · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.0008, CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Right-side regions harbor true tumor at the inferior (323 um) and lateral (108 um) margins [F7].
- Regions 2, 3, and 6 contain InSitu disease like contrast case BACH_0263 (84% similarity), diluted by benign regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 2, 3**: Highest local risk (39%, 14%, 10%) and duct-confined atypia; exclude DCIS or invasion.
2. **Regions 10, 11, 7**: Check inferior (323 um) and lateral (108 um) margins called positive (100% probability).
3. **Regions 4, 5, 8**: Confirm dense lymphocytic infiltrate and benign tubules across zero-risk left-side regions.

found: 'Gland / tubule formation' is tagged Validated but should be Weak (spot check 18/20, caption check failed).
The CONCH–MUSK row names Benign, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
